records.jp: あれがそうだよ。<CR>美弦さん、触れてみて
records.en_original: That's it, Mio. Touch it.
records.en: That's it.<CR>Mio-san, try touching it.

records.jp: お姉ちゃん。どうして私たちには<CR>お父さんがいないの？
records.en_original: Mio... Why don't we have a dad?
records.en: Onee-chan, why don't we<CR>have a dad?

records.jp: ……今まで秘密にしてたけどね。<CR>実はお父さん、世界を救うヒーローなの
records.en_original: Can you keep a secret? The truth is, Dad is a super hero who's busy saving the world.
records.en: ...I've kept it secret until now.<CR>Actually, Dad is a hero who saves the world.

records.jp: だからいつも世界を飛び回ってて、<CR>うちにはなかなか帰ってこれないのよ
records.en_original: He's always flying around the planet, looking for bad guys, so he can't come home very often.
records.en: That's why he's always flying around the world<CR>and can hardly ever come home.

records.jp: でも、全然帰って来ない……
records.en_original: But he never comes home...
records.en: But he never comes home...

records.jp: 一年に一度は、帰ってきてるんだよ。<CR>クリスマスの日、プレゼントを届けに……
records.en_original: He does come back! Once a year on Christmas, when he delivers presents to us.
records.en: He does come home once a year.<CR>On Christmas, to deliver presents...

records.jp: えっ！？<CR>お父さんってヒーローでサンタさんなの！？
records.en_original: Huh?! Dad's a superhero AND Santa Claus?
records.en: What!?<CR>Dad is a hero and Santa Claus!?

records.jp: う……ぐす……
records.en_original: *Sob*... *sniff*...
records.en: *Sob*... *sniff*...

records.jp: 陽桜莉！？　どうしたの！？
records.en_original: Hiori! What's wrong?!
records.en: Hiori! What's wrong?!

records.jp: 学校で、言われたの……。<CR>お母さんは、私たちを捨てたんだって……
records.en_original: At school, they were saying... That Mom left because she doesn't want us...
records.en: They said it at school...<CR>That Mom abandoned us...

records.jp: ……今は泣いていいからね。でも……
records.en_original: It's okay to cry, Hiori...
records.en: ...It's okay to cry now. But...

records.jp: 明日からはまた笑ってくれると<CR>お姉ちゃん嬉しいな
records.en_original: But I hope I get to see your smile again tomorrow.
records.en: Onee-chan would be happy<CR>if you smiled again starting tomorrow.

records.jp: 笑ってる陽桜莉が一番かわいいし……。<CR>幸せは笑ってる子のところに訪れるのよ
records.en_original: You have such a beautiful smile, you know? They say that good things come to smiling faces.
records.en: You are cutest when you're smiling, Hiori...<CR>Happiness visits children who smile.

records.jp: この雨が、織姫と彦星の嬉し涙、かあ……。<CR>そんなこと、考えたこともなかった
records.en_original: So this rain is actually Orihime and Hikoboshi's happy tears? I never thought of it like that.
records.en: So this rain is Orihime and Hikoboshi's tears of joy...<CR>I never thought of it that way.

records.jp: 世界はね。<CR>陽桜莉が思っているより、素敵なものであふれてるのよ
records.en_original: You know, Hiori. There are so many wonderful things in the world. More than you could ever imagine.
records.en: The world, you know,<CR>is overflowing with more wonderful things than you think, Hiori.

records.jp: ……ねえ、お姉ちゃん
records.en_original: Mio?
records.en: Hey, Onee-chan.

records.jp: 私も、お姉ちゃんみたいな景色が見られるように<CR>頑張るね！
records.en_original: I'm gonna try to look at things more like you from now on!
records.en: I'll do my best<CR>so I can see the world the way you do, Onee-chan!

records.jp: これは……小さい頃の、私たち……
records.en_original: That was us when we were little...
records.en: That was us when we were little...

records.jp: ……あの頃の私はネガティブで、<CR>いろんなことを悪く考えていたような気がする
records.en_original: Back then, I had a really negative outlook on everything.
records.en: ...Back then, I was negative,<CR>and I think I looked at many things in the worst possible way.

records.jp: けど、今はすごい前向き。<CR>周りから前向きすぎるって言われるくらい
records.en_original: But now, I'm the complete opposite. In fact, people even say I'm too positive.
records.en: But now I'm incredibly positive.<CR>People around me even say I'm too positive.

records.jp: 変えてくれたのは、お姉ちゃんなんだよ
records.en_original: You changed me, Mio.
records.en: You're the one who changed me, Onee-chan.

records.jp: 私が……
records.en_original: I did...?
records.en: I did...?

records.jp: お父さんのこと、お母さんのこと。<CR>七夕の時も……
records.en_original: Mom... Dad... Tanabata...
records.en: About Dad, about Mom...<CR>and at Tanabata too...

records.jp: お姉ちゃんからあったかい想いをたくさん貰って、<CR>私は今の私になれた
records.en_original: I'm the person I am now thanks to all of the wonderful memories you've given me.
records.en: I received so many warm feelings from you, Onee-chan,<CR>and that is how I became who I am now.

records.jp: お姉ちゃんは、私から想いを借りたなんて<CR>言ってたらしいけど……違うよ
records.en_original: You said that I let you borrow my feelings and memories, but...it's different.
records.en: I heard you said you borrowed feelings from me, Onee-chan,<CR>but that isn't true.

records.jp: だってお姉ちゃんから貰った想いを、<CR>お返ししただけなんだから
records.en_original: I just returned them to you, Mio.
records.en: Because I only returned to you<CR>the feelings I had received from you, Onee-chan.

records.jp: 陽桜莉……
records.en_original: Hiori...
records.en: Hiori...

records.jp: ……美弦さん。<CR>やっぱり美弦さんは美弦さんだよ
records.en_original: Mio. You've been you this entire time.
records.en: ...Mio-san.<CR>You really are still Mio-san.

records.jp: 妹想いで、素敵なことに気づかせてくれる……<CR>大人っぽくて、頭もよくて、優しい人
records.en_original: A person that loves her sister, that makes us notice the wonderful things around us... A person that's smart, mature, and kind.
records.en: A person who loves her younger sister and helps others notice wonderful things...<CR>Mature, intelligent, and kind.

records.jp: 確かに一度は間違えたのかもしれない
records.en_original: It's true that you made a mistake.
records.en: It's true that you made a mistake.

records.jp: でも、美弦さんが陽桜莉さんのおかげで<CR>ここに居られると思っているのと同じように……
records.en_original: But just like how Hiori made you the person you are today...
records.en: But just as you believe you can be here<CR>thanks to Hiori-san, Mio-san...

records.jp: 陽桜莉さんも、美弦さんがいるから<CR>今ここに居られてるって思ってる
records.en_original: You made Hiori into the person she is.
records.en: Hiori-san also believes she can be here now<CR>because you are here, Mio-san.

records.jp: 私だって、美弦さんからたくさん想いを貰って……<CR>今の私があるんだと思う
records.en_original: I think you could say the same about me too. I've made so many memories with you.
records.en: I too received so many feelings from you, Mio-san...<CR>and I think that is why I am who I am today.

records.jp: だから……貰った想いに報いたいとか、<CR>借りた想いを返さなきゃとか、思わなくていいんだ
records.en_original: So you don't have to worry about making up for things anymore.
records.en: So... you don't have to think that you must repay the feelings you received<CR>or return feelings you borrowed.

records.jp: 自分のこと……許してあげられないかな？
records.en_original: Do you think you could ever forgive yourself?
records.en: Could you... forgive yourself?

records.jp: 愛央……
records.en_original: Ao...
records.en: Ao...

records.jp: あなたは……
records.en_original: You're...
records.en: You're...

records.jp: ……ねえ、あなたは私の記憶の中の私？<CR>それとも……陽桜莉の記憶の中の私なの？
records.en_original: Are you the me from my memories? ...Or the me from Hiori's memories?
records.en: ...Tell me, are you the me in my memories?<CR>Or... the me in Hiori's memories?

records.jp: 大事なのは、あなたがどう思って生きていくか。<CR>でしょ？
records.en_original: Only you decide how to live you life.
records.en: What matters is how you choose to think and live.<CR>Isn't that right?

records.jp: 思い出して。<CR>世界は、素敵なものであふれてるって
records.en_original: Remember. There are so many wonderful things in the world.
records.en: Remember.<CR>The world is overflowing with wonderful things.

records.jp: ……そうね。<CR>大事なのは、私がどう思って生きていくか……
records.en_original: She's right. We all decide ourselves how we live.
records.en: ...That's right.<CR>What matters is how I choose to think and live...

records.jp: ねえ、陽桜莉。愛央
records.en_original: Isn't that right?
records.en: Hiori. Ao.

records.jp: うん
records.en_original: Yeah.
records.en: Yeah.

records.jp: 私、間違ってた。<CR>一人で罪悪感を抱えていても、何も生まない
records.en_original: I was wrong. Nothing will come from me feeling sorry for myself.
records.en: I was wrong.<CR>Nothing is born from carrying guilt alone.

records.jp: また失敗してしまうのではないか。<CR>それが怖くて、ずっと立ち止まっていた
records.en_original: I've been terrified that I might fail again. I've been stopped in my tracks for so long...
records.en: I was afraid I might fail again.<CR>That fear kept me standing still all this time.

records.jp: 私に必要だったのは……今の私を受け入れて、<CR>それを乗り越えることだったのよね
records.en_original: What I truly needed was to accept who I am now.
records.en: What I needed was... to accept who I am now<CR>and overcome it.

records.jp: もう、大丈夫。<CR>二人とも……本当にありがとう
records.en_original: I'm all right now. Thank you, both of you.
records.en: I'm all right now.<CR>Both of you... thank you, truly.

records.jp: えへへ
records.en_original: Hehehe!
records.en: Hehehe!

records.jp: あはは
records.en_original: Hahaha!
records.en: Hahaha!

records.jp: ……本当に、愛央にはいろいろお世話になったわね。<CR>この借りは、ちゃんと返さないと
records.en_original: I should thank you for everything you've done for me. I'll find a way to repay you.
records.en: ...You really have done so much for me, Ao.<CR>I must properly repay this debt.

records.jp: まーた借りとか言ってる
records.en_original: There you go, talking like that again.
records.en: There you go, talking like that again.

records.jp: そうだった
records.en_original: Ah, you're right.
records.en: Ah, you're right.

records.jp: あ、そういえば、この前こんなことがあったの。<CR>ずっと愛央に話そうと思っていて……
records.en_original: That reminds me, I've been meaning to tell you about something...
records.en: Ah, speaking of which, something happened the other day.<CR>I've been meaning to tell you about it, Ao...

records.jp: （そういって、美弦さんは身近にあった<CR>いろんな素敵なことを話し始める）
records.en_original: (After that, Mio starting talking with us about wonderful things.)
records.en: (With that, Mio-san began telling us<CR>about all the wonderful things she had found nearby.)

records.jp: （話はどれも興味深いことばかりで、なんとも<CR>思っていなかった景色が急に輝きだしたように思えた）
records.en_original: (Once she started, we couldn't stop listening. The way she thought about the world opened up ways of thinking I had never thought of before.)
records.en: (Every story was fascinating, and scenery I had never thought anything of<CR>suddenly seemed to begin shining.)

records.jp: （でも、何よりも一番輝いて見えるのは……）
records.en_original: (But what shined most brightly...)
records.en: (But the thing that looked most radiant of all was...)

records.jp: （美弦さんの笑顔だと、私は思った）
records.en_original: (Was the way she smiled.)
records.en: (Mio-san's smile, I thought.)
